cards.name: Archetype Resonance
cards.text:
Select and create 1 Archetype card.
The next 3 times an Ego Skill is used, create an additional card.
Decrease Cost of the next Ego Skill used by 2.

cards.name: Matter Disintegration
cards.text: 100% Defense-Based Damage.

cards.name: Barrier Deployment
cards.text: Heal 100%.

cards.name: Quantum Seed
cards.text:
Heal 100%, create 2 Archetype cards in Draw Pile.
Draw 1 of them.

cards.name: Quantum Seed I
cards.text:
Heal 150%.
Create 3 Archetype card(s) in Draw Pile.
Draw 1 of them.

cards.name: Quantum Seed II
cards.text:
Heal 100%.
Select 1 Archetype card.
Create 1 in hand and Draw Pile each.

cards.name: Quantum Seed III
cards.text:
Draw 1.
Predict which Archetype card will be created.
Create 1 Archetype card.
If predicted correctly, create the rest in Draw Pile.

cards.name: Quantum Seed IV
cards.text:
Create 3 Archetype card(s) in Draw Pile.
Draw 1 of them.
Activate Retain effect 2 times on 1 random card(s) of this unit in hand.

cards.name: Quantum Seed V
cards.text:
Create 1 Archetype card(s).
When AP is 0, create 1 Archetype card in hand and Draw Pile each (1 time per turn).

cards.name: Form Convergence
cards.text:
Draw 2 Archetype cards.
Double a random effect of those cards for 1 turn.

cards.name: Form Convergence I
cards.text:
Draw 3 Archetype card(s).
Double a random effect of those cards for 1 turn.

cards.name: Form Convergence II
cards.text:
Draw 4 Archetype card(s).
Select and Exhaust 1 Exhaust card in hand.

cards.name: Form Convergence III
cards.text:
Change all Archetype cards in hand into a different Archetype card.
Retain: Draw 1 Archetype card(s).

cards.name: Form Convergence IV
cards.text:
Select and Exhaust 3 Exhaust cards from all.
Draw 1 Exhaust card for each Exhausted.

cards.name: Form Convergence V
cards.text:
Draw 1 Archetype card.
Repeat until the same card is Drawn consecutively (max 6 time(s)).

cards.name: Creation and Destruction
cards.text:
120% Defense-Based Damage, 80% Shield, Heal 80%.
Harmonization: Double all effects

cards.name: Creation and Destruction I
cards.text:
180% Defense-Based Damage, 100% Shield, Heal 100%.
Harmonization: Double all effects.

cards.name: Creation and Destruction II
cards.text:
550% Defense-Based Damage.
When a card is Exhausted, decrease Cost of this card by 1 for 1 turn until used.

cards.name: Creation and Destruction III
cards.text:
160% Defense-Based Damage, 40% Shield, Heal 40%.
Retain: increase all effects by 100% until activated (max 4 times).

cards.name: Creation and Destruction IV
cards.text:
When AP is 0, create 1 Creation and Destruction.
Decrease Cost of those cards by 1 and apply Exhaust (1 time per turn).

cards.name: Creation and Destruction V
cards.text:
150% Defense-Based Damage for each Cost of this card.
When a card is Exhausted, randomly change Cost of this card from 1–9.

cards.name: Dual Creation
cards.text: When 2 Archetype cards are created, create 1 identical card in Discard Pile.

cards.name: Dual Creation I
cards.text: When 2 Archetype cards are created, create 1 identical card in Discard Pile.

cards.name: Dual Creation II
cards.text:
When 3 Archetype cards are created, create 1 identical card in hand.
Apply Retain to that card.

cards.name: Dual Creation III
cards.text: When Archetype: □ is activated, create 1 different Archetype card in Discard Pile.

cards.name: Dual Creation IV
cards.text:
Create 1 of each Archetype card.
Create 1 of the next Archetype card Exhausted.

cards.name: Dual Creation V
cards.text: When an Archetype card is moved to hand, duplicate that card and remove a random effect (5 time(s) per turn).

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.text:
1 AP.
Draw 1.
Increase Damage Amount of the first Hit of the next Attack Card by 40%.

cards.name: Archetype: ○
cards.text:
Heal 50%.
1 AP.

cards.name: Archetype: △
cards.text:
50% Shield.
Increase Damage Amount of the first Hit of the next Attack Card by 30% (max 300%).

cards.name: Archetype: □
cards.text:
Heal 50%.
Draw 1 Archetype card.

potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Decrease Heal Amount of the Barrier Deployment card to 70% and add a 70% Shield effect.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text:
+5% Heal and Shield Gain Amounts to Archetype cards.
If Tiphera's Defense is greater than 250, add an additional +5% to the modifier.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Tiphera's Defense is greater than 300, at the start of battle, +10% to Critical Damage of allies.

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: Change max Form Upgrade stack count of Event Horizon card from 3 to 4.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text:
When an Archetype card is activated, gain that card's shape effect.
When a shape effect reaches 3 stacks, create 1 card consisting of the stacked shape effects.
○ : Heal 150%.
△ : Increase Damage Amount of the first Hit of the next Attack Card by 30% (Max: 300%).
□ : Draw 1 Archetype card.
This effect activates only 1 time per turn, and shape effect is removed at the end of the turn once its activated.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the additional creation count of Archetype Resonance to 3 times, and increase the Cost decrease effect of the next Ego Skill used to 3.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:
When Tiphera's Archetype card is used, gain the Power of Archetype effect.
Power of Archetype: Increase Damage Amount of Attack Cards of allies by 5%, increase Order Attribute Damage Amount of allies by 5%, increase Defense-Based Damage Amount of allies by 5%.
At the end of the turn, remove Power of Archetype (max 2 stacks).

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text:
Tiphera's Unique Cards receive Damage Amount Increase effects gained from Archetype : △ cards, but are changed to not be consumed.
At the start of battle, change Damage Amount effect gained from Archetype : △ cards to increase from 30% to 35%, and max stacks from 300% to 350%.
